issue.title: Pin historical replay cancellation at the inter-page yield in focused CI tests
issue.body:
Origin: Claude Opus 5.5 xhigh formal scan 1, observation O1, on [PR #490](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/pull/490) at `497acaa602959bc828e8f1e90f2dce0a576a3492` against `98692c8a8c7b519e8c83e585e026d595cedc0550`. The full report SHA-256 is `1f0abc7a32cd9a3b17e98e62cf37f04766ea833e47c11dd8728093a9c45061dc`.

The focused real-TCP test suite closes responses at ownership, initial-thread, checkpoint, boundary and page-read holds, but does not close at the inter-page `setImmediate` yield in `apps/api/src/run-history.ts`. Static review indicates removing just the post-yield guard could escape these focused tests. This was not established by a mutation run.

The current implementation is correct at this boundary in independent compiled-route/native evidence: the accepted `closed-at-yield` case changes five further baseline pages to zero, preserves connected responses and records cleanup. [Candidate evidence](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/497acaa602959bc828e8f1e90f2dce0a576a3492/docs/qa/2026-11-15-history-disconnect-candidate/README.md). The follow-up improves ongoing CI regression protection; it is not an unverified product fix or a reason to repeat the accepted native matrix.

Acceptance:
- Add a focused regression at the actual inter-page yield after a completed replay page, with an observed outgoing response close before releasing the yield.
- Establish that no subsequent repository page starts, and retain normal connected responses, late-rejection policy, request isolation and cleanup.
- Demonstrate that the targeted regression detects removal/breakage of the yield cancellation check. Record exactly which test/source bytes were used and distinguish static reasoning from an executed mutation.
- Use bounded event ordering instead of elapsed sleeps; preserve the current test workload, coverage floors and production scheduling behavior.
- Obtain independent opposite-family review and touched-system QA.

Disposition: DEFER-ISSUE, P3 test maintainability. Parked under `backlog`; no implementation is dispatched and #419's current native evidence remains its accepted yield criterion proof.

Duplicate check: searched open and closed issues for yield/disconnect, setImmediate, and historical/disconnect. #419 describes the product defect; no separate focused-yield regression issue was found.
